sources.instructions: Stage the official SourceForts Classic 1.0 RC7 (Fix) 7z linked from the ModDB project page. That build is the 32-bit SDK 2013 port and matches Steam app 244310 on the previous2021 branch. Do not stage the 1.1b3 Linux64 pre-release; this depot has no srcds_linux64. Copy the complete sfclassic/ tree, including maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. The map sentinel does not prove completeness.

manual_reason: Manual full-distribution staging is required. These known file sentinels do not establish completeness; inspect the game-specific source instructions.
